# GitHub logins that may release Xchonnect, each with the fingerprints of the SSH signing
# keys they sign release tags with. One maintainer per line:
#
#   <login> SHA256:<fingerprint> [SHA256:<fingerprint> ...]
#
# A fingerprint is what `ssh-keygen -lf <key>.pub` prints in its second column.
#
# scripts/release-gate.sh accepts a release tag only when it is signed with a key that is
# both on that login's GitHub account as a signing key (Settings -> SSH and GPG keys ->
# New SSH key, key type "Signing Key") and pinned here. A key added to the account
# alone, by a stolen session or token, signs nothing that releases.
# scripts/release-approval-check.sh requires the `release` environment of the publishing
# run to be approved by one of these logins; with two or more listed, by one who did not
# sign the tag (the two-person rule).
#
# Both scripts read this file from `main` through the GitHub API, never from the tagged
# commit, so a change takes effect once it is merged to main, for every run after that,
# and a tag on a side branch that edits this file vouches for nothing. The main ruleset
# must offer no bypass for that merge (docs/release.md, "What the owner configures").
# Keep the logins in step with the required reviewers of the `release` environment.
#
# maximedogawa: "Mac mini Signing" (RSA 4096, signed v0.1.0-rc.4) and
# "Mac Book Pro signing" (ED25519), both uploaded 2026-10-06.
maximedogawa SHA256:po7rz5P722J/GglMH/UUdea/S+syQMNuDxT57PfWd6Q SHA256:62dQUfSsPtNrSbfSMFRYBgQLp5Ei+ycQleHC6M+R7yc
